notes.title: Patch released!
notes.content:
We have released a new patch supporting:

- Fixed the issue where only certain items ("Scroll of Body", "Clump of Sugar", "Leaf Remedy (XL)") were produced when the Roulette was spun right after launching the game.
- Fixed the issue where the names of Kami arts shown on the weapon screen of the Coin Exchange were switched under certain circumstances.
- Corrected some typos.
